Tests shred destination selection, batching, contact changes, and performance.

# Purpose
This C file is a test program for `fd_shred_dest` and related leader schedule code. It imports binary fixture data for validator pubkeys, destination tables, broadcast peers, retransmit peers, and a testnet destination set, then builds `fd_epoch_leaders_t` and `fd_shred_dest_t` objects from that data. The file checks that `fd_shred_dest_compute_first` and `fd_shred_dest_compute_children` return the same results as the reference fixture data, and it also checks error handling, contact updates, and behavior when the validator set is truncated.

The file also contains property-style tests that vary stake values, radix values, batch size, and source contact data to verify that destination selection forms a tree and that batching gives the same results as single-shred calls. The [`test_performance`](<#test_performance>) function measures compute time for child selection with 1-shred and 16-shred batches. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs all tests in sequence after `fd_boot`, then prints `pass` and exits through `fd_halt`.
